title: rubus gratus var. sciaphilus
intro: Rubus gratus var. sciaphilus, commonly known as the Wood's thimbleberry, is a variant of the thimbleberry plant species. It is a type of shrub native to North America, characterized by its edible fruits and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rubus gratus var. sciaphilus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress, alleviate pain, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and tannins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral activities.
